judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the core bug remains unfixed and the newly added test will fail. It also completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. While the candidate updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, it left the bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section without explaining what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened, which was an explicit acceptance criterion. Finally, it committed an internal `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad file and created a separate test file instead of adding to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
